map.根据末次月经(LMP)及早期B超(CRL/双顶径)推算并校正孕周与预产期: Estimate and correct gestational age and EDD from LMP and early ultrasound (CRL/BPD)
map.孕周 = 末次月经(LMP) + 280 天 或 超声径线校正；周期长度调整预产: GA = LMP + 280 days or ultrasound biometry; cycle length adjusts EDD
map.结合 LMP 与超声测量重新确定孕周，周期差调整预产期（周期超过 28 天后延/: Combine LMP and ultrasound to re-determine GA; cycle difference adjusts EDD (cycles >28 days shift later/earlier).
map.注：早孕期CRL(45–84mm)是确定孕周最准确的方法(误差±5天)。月经周期: Note: first-trimester CRL (45-84 mm) is the most accurate way to date pregnancy (error +/-5 days). Irregular cycles should rely on ultrasound.
map.提示：月经周期≠28天时，排卵日可能不同。周期>28天者预产期应相应后推(周期天: Tip: when cycle != 28 days, ovulation day may differ. For cycles >28 days, EDD shifts later by (cycle days - 28). Early CRL is the gold standard for ultrasound correction; for clinical reference only.
map.按 LMP 或早孕期超声（CRL/BPD）推算当前孕周与 EDD。: Estimate current GA and EDD by LMP or first-trimester ultrasound (CRL/BPD).
map.LMP 不清时以超声孕周为准。: When LMP is unclear, use ultrasound GA.
map.核对末次月经与超声孕周差异。: Check the LMP vs ultrasound GA difference.

map.CRL 和 LMP 哪个准？: Which is more accurate, CRL or LMP?
map.孕 7–13 周 CRL 推算最准（误差 ±5–7 天），优先于 LMP；>14: At 7-13 wks CRL is most accurate (error +/-5-7 days), preferred over LMP; after >14 wks BPD/HC error grows.
map.一般相差 >7 天（早孕期）或 >10–14 天（中晚孕）时以超声校正: Generally >7 days (first trimester) or >10-14 days (mid/late) then correct by ultrasound
